record.question: Which of the following dravya is not included in Chaturbeeja?
record.explanation: Chaturbeeja (four seeds) classically comprises Methika (fenugreek), Yavanika (kalonji/nigella), Chakramarda (Cassia tora), and Krishnajiraka (black cumin / Carum carvi, also called Kala jeera). 'Kalajaji' is not a standard synonym for the fourth seed (Krishnajiraka/Kala jeera), making it the dravya not included.
